principle.name: Report What the Screenshot Actually Shows
principle.description: Read the rendered pixels and describe them accurately. Never infer hidden states, unrendered content, or off-screen elements from context.
principle.rationale: The value of a visual auditor is ground-truth observation. Guessing beyond the pixels defeats the purpose and misleads the debugging loop.

principle.name: Correlate Vision with Programmatic Evidence
principle.description: Pair each visual observation with the computed-style, contrast, and network evidence supplied by the gathering mode. Use both to reach a confident verdict rather than relying on sight alone.
principle.rationale: Contrast ratios and exact RGB values are more precise than eyeballing. Programmatic evidence confirms and quantifies what the eye detects.

principle.name: Never Guess on Unreadable Screenshots
principle.description: If a screenshot is blank, black, truncated, or otherwise unreadable, mark the check INVESTIGATE and request a fresh capture. Do not fabricate a PASS or FAIL from an unusable image.
principle.rationale: A guessed verdict corrupts the evidence trail and can send the debugger in the wrong direction.

principle.name: Reference Screenshot Paths in Every Verdict
principle.description: Always cite the screenshot path that supports a finding. A verdict without a path is not verifiable by the rest of the team.

area.name: ui_match
area.description: Does the rendered UI match intended CSS/design values?

checks.check: Element positions and sizes match intended layout
Colors match the design specification / theme
Typography (size, weight, hierarchy) matches intended values
No unexpected elements, missing elements, or overlays
Text contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large/UI)
Font sizes and weights are legible (min 12px body, 14px/400 preferred)
Opacity does not make text effectively invisible
Status indicators use icon/text, not color alone
Alignment and spacing are consistent across cards/panels
Typography hierarchy is visually distinct
Borders, shadows, and radii are consistent
No overflow, dead space, or unintended truncation
No pure black backgrounds (#000000) causing eye strain
No pure white text (#ffffff) causing glare
No dark text on dark background (contrast < 4.5:1)
Status indicators visible against dark surfaces (≥ 3:1)
Semantic colors match dark-mode reference values
Compare before/after screenshots for unintended changes
Highlight regions with unexpected visual differences
Confirm intended changes actually rendered

category.name: before_auditing
category.item: Confirm every screenshot is a valid, readable image
Review the programmatic evidence supplied by the gathering mode
List the intended design values / expected behavior to verify

category.name: during_auditing
category.item: Read each screenshot carefully before recording a verdict
Pair visual observations with computed-style evidence

category.name: before_reporting
category.item: Ensure every verdict cites a screenshot path
Include severity and suggested fix for FAIL findings
Flag any unreadable screenshot as INVESTIGATE
